final: WITH status_shares AS (SELECT powerstatus, COUNT(*) AS telescope_count, 100.0 * COUNT(*) / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM telescopes) AS share FROM telescopes GROUP BY powerstatus), average_share AS (SELECT AVG(share) AS share FROM status_shares) SELECT SUM(telescope_count) AS total_telescopes, AVG(status_shares.share) AS average_share, AVG(status_shares.share - average_share.share) AS average_excess_share FROM status_shares CROSS JOIN average_share WHERE status_shares.share > average_share.share
